title: Templo Mayor of Tenochtitlan
summary: The Templo Mayor was the main temple of Tenochtitlan, the Mexica capital, dedicated to Tlaloc and Huitzilopochtli and rebuilt in seven construction stages. It was destroyed in the war of 1521, lay buried for centuries and was rediscovered in the 20th century in what is now central Mexico City.

uncertainty.note: 1325 is the approximate settlement date of the Mexica on the island, per INAH; the date of the first temple stage was not confirmed on an opened page, so the start is a loose bound. End is destruction in the war of 1521.
